title: Profile
description: Personal profile data displayed in the portfolio hero and terminal widget, including contact links, bio copy, and the animated terminal line sequence.

title.description: Current job title or professional role.

bio.description: Short biography sentence used in the about section.

tagline.description: Short punchy tagline displayed as a subtitle.

avatar.description: Relative or absolute URL to the avatar image.

terminalLines.description: Ordered sequence of lines rendered in the animated terminal widget.

type.title: TerminalLineType
type.description: Line role: 'prompt' renders a shell prompt, 'output' renders response text, 'blank' renders an empty line, 'cursor' renders the blinking cursor.

text.description: Raw text content of the line. Empty string for blank and cursor lines.
